gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Remapping
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Remapping
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

gripOrHq.title: Unlisted Research Lab
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Reclamation Project
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Baskerville
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *Trace5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Baskerville counter by taking an action to spend [3]. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Baskerville is reduced by [5].

gripOrHq.title: London City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: Dumpster
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Dumpster cannot be installed on the Archives. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on the Archives, instead of passing Dumpster. The run is now considered to be a run on the Archives. If there is no rezzed ice on the Archives, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on the Archives.

heapOrArchives.title: Satellite Monitors
heapOrArchives.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Self-Destruct
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

heapOrArchives.title: Trapdoor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Install Trapdoor only on R&D or HQ. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a subsidiary data fort of your choice, instead of passing Trapdoor. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort. Runner automatically breaks this subroutine if there are no subsidiary data forts.

heapOrArchives.title: Deadeye
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Deadeye is reduced by [5].

heapOrArchives.title: Self-Destruct
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

heapOrArchives.title: Badtimes
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Strategic Planning Group
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

heapOrArchives.title: Rockerboy Promotion
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

discardCards.title: Startup Immolator
discardCards.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

discardCards.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

discardCards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

discardCards.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

scoreArea.title: Superserum
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

scoreArea.title: Unlisted Research Lab
scoreArea.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.
